user.title: Cerberus Lookup
user.description:
Detected right now: {detected}.

The network you are going out through is already in the table below, without a name. Open the link to see who it belongs to, then type the name you want the sensor to show:

`35612 = Eolo`

One provider per line. You do not have to add them all now: whenever the sensor shows the unknown label, reopen this dialog and the network in use will be waiting here for a name.

data.unknown_label: Label when the provider is not in the table

init.title: Cerberus Lookup
init.description:
Detected right now: {detected}.

If the network in use was not mapped yet, it has been appended to the table without a name. Open the link to see who it belongs to, then type the name you want the sensor to show:

`35612 = Eolo`

One provider per line. Lines that cannot be read are ignored, so a typo costs one provider and never a dialog that refuses to close.

data.unknown_label: Label when the provider is not in the table
